top_signals.title: FlyDubai Suspends Israel Flights After Mid-Air Attack
top_signals.summary:
"The Pulse With Francine Lacqua" is all about conversations with high profile guests in the beating heart of global business, economics, finance and politics. Based in London, we go wherever the story is, bringing you exclusive interviews and market-moving scoops.

Today's guests: Jim Bianco, Bianco Research President and Macro Strategist; Leo Barincou, Oxford Economics Senior Economist; Benedetta Berti, NATO Parliamentary Assembly Secretary General (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Copper Retreats as Oil Rally, Stronger Dollar Weigh on Metals
top_signals.summary: Copper retreated, as upswings in oil prices and the US dollar weighed on metals while traders assessed a shifting supply outlook.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Latvia Says It Detained Two People for Spying for Russia
top_signals.summary: Latvia’s security services said they detained a couple on suspicion of working for Russia to collect information about the Baltic country’s defenses.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Crypto hacks top $768M in September, worst month of 2026
top_signals.summary: The $388 million Bitget breach and $320 million Liquid Network exploit accounted for most of September’s losses, though more than $270 million from the latter was later returned.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
